main.description: Reserve a World handle and keys for 24 hours. Service auth must name the owner as issuer and this tenor's bare service DID as audience. A retry with the same op and fields returns the live original reservation; changing fields with the same op is invalid. A different op from the same owner supersedes an unsigned draft for the handle and invalidates its keys. A submitted genesis cannot be superseded. The owner signs the returned PLC genesis on their device; the DID is derived from that signed genesis.

op.description: Client-chosen operation ID, unique per owner.

rotationKey.description: The owner's public P-256 or K-256 did:key, listed first for PLC recovery priority. Never send the private key.

tenorRotationKey.description: Opt in to a tenor-held recovery key listed after the owner's key.

visibility.description: Initial meta Space visibility. Omit for private. Public Worlds publish a group declaration in their public repo.

name.description: Initial group profile display name. If omitted, the World handle is used.

operation.description: Unsigned plc_operation genesis with prev explicitly null.

signingBytes.description: Unpadded base64url of the raw canonical DAG-CBOR unsigned operation. Sign the decoded bytes with ECDSA using rotationKey and SHA-256, not a precomputed digest.

expiresAt.description: Unix seconds; createWorld must begin before this instant.

errors.name: HandleTaken
errors.description: The handle is already in use, reserved by another owner, or has a submitted genesis.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The operation ID is invalid or was reused with different fields.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: The issuer's DID document could not be resolved; retry with a fresh service token.
